speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, can you tell me exactly how long you have had the pruritic rash and the numbness in your palms? Also, have you noticed any changes in the color of your hands, such as them turning white or blue, especially when exposed to cold or stress?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your exposure to rice farming and livestock, have you noticed any specific triggers for the rash, such as contact with water or certain animals? Also, does the numbness and tingling follow a specific distribution, like a "glove" pattern, or is it more diffuse?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience pain or tenderness when touching these hypopigmented macules on your elbows, and have you noticed any reduction in sweating on your palms? I need to rule out Hansen's disease given the specific combination of sensory loss, skin changes, and eyebrow thinning.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical history. Social history: Works as a farmer, no history of travel outside the local area.

speaker: Doctor
text: You mentioned working on a rice farm and caring for livestock; have you had any direct skin contact with cattle or buffaloes? I need to rule out cutaneous larva migrans or other zoonotic infections, though the eyebrow thinning is quite specific.

speaker: Patient
text: Denies fever, weight loss, changes in vision, or any respiratory symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any history of contact with pigs, as they are the primary reservoir for the parasite I suspect? REQUEST TEST: Skin biopsy
